tests/SdAiAgent/Core/CompletedTurnCompactorTest.php: 1

`93-99`: ** Trivial** · **Maintainability & Code Quality** · **Quick win** **Add a single-key numeric case that fails without the object cast.** The 200-field fixture does not protect the `(object)` cast in `compact_argument_text()`. That input exceeds the budget, so `compact_arguments()` takes its bounded fallback. The fallback adds the string keys `_compacted` and `_omitted_fields`, which makes the result an object even without the cast. A single-key input such as `{"0":"<3000 characters>"}` takes a different path. Compaction replaces the long value with a short note and keeps only key `0`. The result is a sequential array. Without the cast, it encodes as a JSON list, which the new test would not detect. Add a case with one numeric key and a 3000-character value. Keep the existing 200-field case, because it covers the bounded fallback.
Suggested test addition

```diff $list = (string) wp_json_encode( array_fill( 0, 200, str_repeat( 'l', 100 ) ) ); $this->assertSame( $list, CompletedTurnCompactor::compact_argument_text( $list ) ); + + $single = (string) wp_json_encode( (object) array( 0 => str_repeat( 'n', 3000 ) ) ); + $text = CompletedTurnCompactor::compact_argument_text( $single ); + $this->assertStringStartsWith( '{', $text ); + $this->assertInstanceOf( \stdClass::class, json_decode( $text ) ); ```
